items.title: DataNirnaya - Supply Chain Intelligence Platform
items.impact: Unified forecasting, inventory, supplier risk, and anomaly detection in one executive workspace.
items.summary: Full-stack platform fusing four ML services into a single decision surface for ops leaders. React + Vite + Tailwind + Recharts on the front; FastAPI microservices on the back.
highlights: Modular API abstraction so frontend renders identically on mock or live data
FastAPI microservices for Prophet/LightGBM forecasting, Isolation Forest anomaly, XGBoost supplier scoring
items.problem: Ops leaders run forecasting, supplier risk, and anomaly detection in four separate tools. No one trusts the picture.
items.approach: Single React workspace pulling from four FastAPI services through a unified API layer. Mock-data parity so the UI ships before the models do.
items.outcome: One workspace, four production ML services, one number leadership can defend on Monday.

items.title: LoanLens - Compliance Copilot for Retail Lending
items.impact: Source-grounded compliance Q&A, calibrated credit decisions, and RAGAS quality checks in one lending workspace.
items.summary: LoanLens turns RBI master directions and internal credit policy into an auditable GenAI service for retail lending teams. It combines hybrid retrieval, citation-forced answers, XGBoost decisioning, SHAP explanations, and evaluation tracking.
highlights: Hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion and cross-encoder reranking
Credit decisioning with calibrated XGBoost scores and SHAP-grounded explanations
RAGAS evaluation dashboard tracking faithfulness, context precision, and answer relevancy
items.problem: Compliance and credit teams cannot rely on black-box LLM answers when retail lending decisions must be explainable, policy-grounded, and auditable.
items.approach: A React + FastAPI product with hybrid retrieval over RBI and internal policy documents, citation-forced generation, calibrated credit scoring, SHAP explanations, and a RAGAS harness for quality control.
items.outcome: A portfolio-ready proof of concept that answers lending policy questions with citations, explains applicant decisions, and surfaces quality metrics before a model reaches production.
